title_or_table: Federal Workforce Data, Federal Employment Raw Data (EHRI status files), August 2024 (version 4) and August 2026 (version 1), employees counted by department or independent agency
table_id: data.opm.gov employment files employment_202408_4 and employment_202608_1
observation_period: Last day of August 2024 and last day of August 2026
universe_or_base: Federal civilian employees in the files, in pay or non-pay status, by department or independent agency; the files leave out intelligence agencies and some others that do not report to OPM, and the U.S. Postal Service
unit: employees, summed by the studio from the record-level count field
vintage: August 2024 version 4 (published October 3, 2026) and August 2026 version 1 (published October 4, 2026)
qualification: Counts people on the rolls on one day, full-time and part-time alike. OPM's site warned on November 11, 2026 that a change in Department of War data processing left September 2026 data incomplete for some components, so this file compares August with August; OPM may revise August 2026 in later versions. Department names are as the files give them

department_code.description: OPM department or agency code; ALL is every row

department.description: department or agency as named in the files

printed_source_line: Source: U.S. Office of Personnel Management, Federal Workforce Data, employment status files, August 2024 and August 2026, federal civilian workforce. Retrieved November 11, 2026. People on the rolls on one day; some agencies, including intelligence agencies and the Postal Service, are not in the files.
unconfirmed: The list of agencies outside the files is from OPM's general documentation and was not checked against the August 2026 release notes
